skill.summary: 专业服务中国大陆A股股票，提供实时行情、个股分析、大盘情绪、热点板块、交易策略及价格预警。

latestVersion.changelog:
a-stock-trading-assistant-custom v1.0.0

- Initial release of an intelligent trading assistant dedicated to China's A-share stocks (沪深A股).
- Responds to queries on real-time stock quotes, individual stock analysis, market trends, hot sectors, trading strategies, price alerts, and volume/technical/fundamental analysis.
- Only supports A-shares (codes starting with 6/00/30/68); automatically ignores Hong Kong and US stocks.
- Fetches real-time data from 东方财富, 新浪财经, 同花顺, and 雪球 via scripts and web requests.
- Provides clear workflows for real-time queries, comprehensive analysis, sentiment monitoring, sector analysis, strategy advice, and price alerts.
